# Odyssey Travel

> A guide to Sikh holy places, gurdwaras, historical sites and community places in Pakistan, with history, location and a direct WhatsApp/email contact for visit planning.

## Key pages
- [Home](/): overview, featured places, how to plan a visit
- [All places](/places): every listed gurdwara and heritage site, filterable by type and province
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): full list of place pages

## Notes
- Place pages include city, province, coordinates where known, history, and photo credits (Wikimedia Commons licences).
